text:
mike: Anyone seeing a jump in pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1? ~200 tiny jobs pending and eviction flurry.

alex: Yep, noticed it around 10:10. Scheduler keeps reassigning but pods never stabilize. Lots of small pods churn -> packing fragmentation.

priya: Can you paste any kubelet / attach logs?

alex: ```
Jul 12 10:12:03 node-rack1-02 kubelet[1842]: attach/detach: error on volume attach: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = attach failed: conntrack: can't allocate new entry
Jul 12 10:12:04 kube-scheduler[910]: Evicting pod gpu-job-xyz due to preemption: node resources rebalanced
Jul 12 10:12:05 kube-proxy[221]: conntrack table full, dropping packet
```

jordan: This looks like conntrack table exhaustion on a subset of racks — warm-pool handoff + many ephemeral tiny jobs creating NAT entries. We've seen similar when warmpool churn spikes.

mike: Also saw a pattern: those tiny jobs have strict podAntiAffinity/affinity that pins them to the same racks, amplifying local NAT usage. Scheduler is effectively shadowing slots on a few nodes.

priya: Quick mitigation: increase net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on the affected nodes and relax the affinity for tiny-gpu workloads. I'm testing a canary now.

alex: Instead of relaxing affinity everywhere, can we add a topologySpreadConstraint for tiny-gpu jobs to prefer spreading across racks? That should reduce conntrack concentration while keeping locality when useful.

infra-bot: Deploy event: conntrack-tuning-canary rolled to ap-southeast1 (nodes: node-rack1-02,node-rack1-03,node-rack1-04).

jordan: Cost tradeoff note: spreading will increase cross-rack egress slightly but prevents repeated preemptions which kill throughput. Estimate ~ $0.8/hr per 1k tiny jobs for the canary profile.

mike: Plan: (1) roll conntrack increase on all warmpool nodes in rack-1, (2) push scheduler tweak to prefer spread for pods with label `tiny-gpu=true`, (3) add an alert and run 60m canary. I can open the PR + rollout.

priya: I'll own the canary dashboard and alerts. Alert proposed: `pod_eviction_rate > 5/min for 5m` scoped to ap-southeast1.

alex: Thanks — tagging @oncall for visibility and asking infra to hold any autoscaler changes until we see canary results. :thumbsup:

mike: FYI, temporary knob we used earlier: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `iptables -t raw -I PREROUTING 1 -p tcp -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -m limit --limit 500/sec -j ACCEPT` — can be reversed after canary.

priya: will update runbook with steps and rollback.

jordan: post-canary metric to watch: `kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending",region="ap-southeast1"}` and `node_conntrack_utilization`.

mike: PR link when ready and I'll coordinate the 1-hr window.
